reason: ₹1,999 every month for a year is too much for a washing machine when my wife already hand-washes and the money is needed for diesel, seed and the pump. Even a normal washer would be a stretch for us, never mind one with a battery.
objection: A cold wash on battery won't get the red mud out of my field clothes, so we will still be scrubbing by hand, and I'd be paying a big EMI for something that only half does the job. Also the water comes from the borewell, and that needs power too.
would_change_my_mind: An EMI under ₹900 a month, with the dealer showing me it really cleans muddy farm clothes before I sign.
